import sys

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if len(data) < 2:
        print("no")
        return
    A = data[0]
    B = data[1]
    if len(A) < 2:
        print("no")
        return
    # Check all length-2 substrings of A
    for i in range(len(A) - 1):
        sub = A[i:i+2]
        if sub in B:
            print("yes")
            return
    print("no")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
